input: Open a high-yield savings account today

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether they want an online bank, credit union, or traditional bank narrows the field of eligible accounts significantly and changes the entire research path.
Minimum opening deposit requirements vary widely (from $0 to $10,000+); knowing how much they can deposit determines which accounts they actually qualify for.
Whether this is a personal account, joint account, or business account affects eligibility rules, required documentation, and the application process.
Their country and state of residence affects which institutions are available to them and any regional regulations or tax implications.
Their top priority — highest APY, no fees, FDIC insurance, ease of access, ATM access, or brand trust — determines which account wins the trade-off.
Whether they already have a preferred bank or have done any research determines whether the plan starts from scratch or picks up mid-process.
Whether they want the new account linked to an existing checking account (and at which bank) affects which institutions offer seamless transfers and whether switching costs matter.

gold.taskTitle: Open a high-yield savings account today
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to open a high-yield savings account, likely as soon as possible, but key details about their financial situation, preferences, and goals will determine which account and approach is best.

questions.title: Do you prefer an online bank, credit union, or traditional bank?
questions.description: Identifies the type of institution the user is comfortable banking with, which filters the entire list of candidate accounts.

questions.title: How much are you planning to deposit to open the account?
questions.description: Determines which accounts the user qualifies for based on minimum opening deposit requirements.

questions.title: Will this be a personal, joint, or business account?
questions.description: Affects eligibility, required documentation, and the application steps involved.

questions.title: Which country and state or region are you based in?
questions.description: Determines which institutions are available to the user and any relevant regional regulations.

questions.title: What is your single most important feature in this account?
questions.description: Clarifies the user's top priority — such as highest APY, zero fees, FDIC insurance, or ATM access — to rank options correctly.

questions.title: Have you already researched or shortlisted any specific banks?
questions.description: Establishes whether the plan starts from scratch or whether the user is close to a decision and just needs help completing the application.

questions.title: Which bank holds your current checking account for transfers?
questions.description: Identifies the user's existing bank so the new account can be linked for seamless deposits and withdrawals.
